known_defects_found_and_fixed.summary: Global ambient audio (entry-ambient.mp3) autoplayed on /drift-greybox-lab, violating this lot's own 'no audio autoplay' requirement.

known_defects_found_and_fixed.also_affected: /drift-kit-lab (DRIFT-IV-PRE-30, already owner-accepted) — confirmed live before the fix, autoplaying identically.
known_defects_found_and_fixed.fix: Added /drift-kit-lab and /drift-greybox-lab to both files' route lists; replaced GlobalAudioPlayer.tsx's regex with the same array/startsWith check AudioPlayerProvider.tsx already used.
